name: animate-grid
title: 3D Hover Grid
description: A four-by-four grid of dark emoji tiles shown at a 3D angle. Hovering a tile pops it forward on a white fill with a green glow, and its four neighbours rise a little too.
use: A small set of icons or logos should feel tactile and react together as the cursor moves.
avoid: Hover is the only trigger, so on touch devices nothing lifts and the grid stays inert.
a11y: Tiles are plain divs with mouse listeners only: no tab stop, no keyboard path, and the emoji have no labels. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall narrow block holding sixteen small square tiles in a four-column grid, tilted in perspective so the left edge recedes. Each tile carries a coloured emoji, a thin pale border and a soft pale shadow on a black stage.
behaves: On pointer enter, the hovered tile scales up, shifts toward the viewer, turns white and pulses a green drop-shadow glow; the tiles directly above, below and beside it lift slightly. Leaving eases everything back after a short delay.
customise: Feed items through the cards array and draw each with renderCard; perspective, the two rotations and the glow colours are props, while the lift and white fill are in the source.
weight: light: Sixteen divs with CSS transitions and two keyframe glows; idle until a pointer enters.
